name: Weekly sales pipeline reviewer
why: Runs the weekly deal export review from the pipeline-and-forecast-review skill: what changed, deals to act on and a fix list to approve.

name: Monthly lost deal reviewer
why: A monthly version of the win-loss prompt that turns lost deals into real reasons and pitch changes.

name: Deal win reason finder
why: Finds why you really win from deal notes, the other half of a win-loss review.

name: Stalled deal revival desk
why: Takes a deal flagged at risk in the pipeline review and works out why it stalled and what to send.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Tracks monthly cancellations and whether last month's fix worked, matching the monthly billing and churn close.

name: Cancel reason save planner
why: Turns billing cancellation reasons into one save action per reason and the numbers to track.

name: Refund request reply writer
why: Drafts the customer reply for each item in the refund and billing change queue.

name: Lead grader
why: A quick A, B, C grading of prospects for teams not ready for a full lead scoring model.

name: Sales pay plan checker
why: Checks what a commission plan rewards before quotas are shared; pay terms still go to a qualified adviser.

name: Offer useful information first and follow up with stalled leads
why: A ready nurture plan for leads sent back from sales under the handoff agreement.

name: Sales funnel drop-off finder
why: Finds the worst drop-off step before leads ever reach the CRM pipeline.
